title: Comparison of spectral-norm and embedded integral condensed coefficients
statement: Let ℓ be prime and E a finite extension of Q_ℓ with its spectral norm [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. There exists a finite intermediate field F of the fixed algebraic closure [def-weil-finite-subextension-directed-set] such that the condensed ring of continuous functions into the integer ring of E is isomorphic, as a ring object of condensed abelian groups [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring], to the embedded condensed integer ring of F. The profinite-site universe is arbitrary.

source.place: spectralNorm_unique_field_norm_ext; coefficient comparison for the integral-heart setting

proof.text: Choose an algebra embedding of E into the fixed algebraic closure and take its field range F. Transport a finite basis to show F is a finite intermediate field. The ambient algebraic-closure norm pulled back along the embedding extends the p-adic norm, so uniqueness of the extending absolute value makes the induced field equivalence isometric. The membership description of the recorded integer ring identifies its elements with the norm-at-most-one ball. Restrict the isometry to get a ring equivalence of the two integer rings with continuous inverse. Postcomposition with this equivalence and its inverse defines inverse natural morphisms of continuous-function ring sheaves. Forget to abelian sheaves, retaining the ring-homomorphism structure, to obtain the desired ring-object isomorphism.

proof_origin.place: spectralNorm_unique_field_norm_ext and the sectionwise continuous-function construction

from.place: Identification of the two finite integral coefficient conventions before applying heart closure

lean.statement:
theorem integralCoefficientRingComparison (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (E : Type) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic ℓ) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic ℓ) E] :
    let := spectralNorm.normedField (Padic ℓ) E
    ∃ F : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields ℓ (PadicAlgCl ℓ),
      Nonempty (Mon.mk (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u}
        (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers ℓ E)) ≅
        Mon.mk (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj.{u} ℓ F.val))
